topic: OpenAI charges $80 to reset a $200 plan
angle: The subscription you pay for now has a second paywall inside it
hook: OpenAI now charges $80 to reset a $200 plan
caption:
You pay $200 a month. You hit the usage cap. Resetting it costs another $80. This is the direction premium AI pricing is going, and it is worth understanding before you build a business that depends on one provider's cap. The fix is not outrage — it is not being locked to a single vendor.

💬 Comment "COSTS" and I'll send you the full list.
🔖 Save this for the next time you need it.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#openai #chatgpt #aitools #pricing #saas #freelancing

slides.text: OpenAI now charges *$80* to reset a $200 plan
slides.subline: The subscription has a paywall inside it

slides.text: A subscription used to mean you were done paying. Now it means you are done paying until the cap.

slides.caption: what a $200 plan actually costs the month you hit the ceiling

slides.title: Know your real ceiling
slides.body: Most people have no idea what their usage cap is until they hit it mid-task. Find the number before you build a workflow that depends on it being there.

slides.left_text: Their cap is your cap. Their price change is your price change.
slides.right_text: A cap becomes an inconvenience instead of a stopped business.

slides.title: Keep a second key warm
slides.body: Have a working account with a second provider before you need it. Not as your main tool — as the thing you switch to on the day the cap lands mid-deadline.

slides.text: Save this before you need it
slides.subline: Send it to someone still paying for this
